title: Specs Pipeline
description: Work a workspace runs over its specs. Entries carry no output paths: transformers write into the spec structure, and analyses write beside the specs they analyze.

TransformEntry.description: A single transformer to run, identified by name. Transformer-specific options sit inline alongside name.

AnalysisEntry.description: A single analysis to run, identified by name. Analysis-specific options sit inline alongside name.

Pipeline.description: Transformers and analyses a workspace runs.
